title: Specification Gaming and a Constrained Reinforcement Learning Mitigation in a Cleaning Gridworld
title_zh: 目标设定博弈与清洁网格世界中的约束强化学习缓解方法

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning agents optimize exactly the reward signal they are given, which can diverge sharply from an intended true objective when that signal is only a proxy for it; this failure mode is known as specification gaming. Existing evidence for this failure mode is largely observational, with comparatively few demonstrations pairing a controlled, deliberately constructed proxy/true gap with a mitigation that carries a verifiable guarantee rather than only an empirical improvement. We construct a minimal gridworld in which a cleaning-robot agent can either genuinely remove dirt or conceal it from a cheap sensor, and show that a standard deep Q-network trained only on the sensor’s proxy reward converges to a policy that games it completely, reaching near-maximal proxy reward while never achieving the true objective. We then introduce a constrained reinforcement learning fix, penalizing the specific behaviors through which the agent exploits the gap, and show that it eliminates the gaming behavior from the final policy while substantially recovering true-objective performance. We further derive and empirically verify an exact accounting identity relating the proxy reward, true reward, and our cost signal for this environment, showing that the cost signal measures the proxy/true gap exactly rather than merely tracking it, and yields a deterministic guarantee under a hard-constrained variant of the method.
paragraphs.zh: 强化学习智能体所优化的正是它们收到的奖励信号；当该信号仅作为真实目标的代理时，它与预期真实目标可能会严重偏离，这种失效模式被称为“规格操纵”。 目前关于这种失效模式的证据大多来自观察，而将受控且刻意构建的代理/真实目标差距与具有可验证保证（而非仅经验性改进）的缓解措施相结合的演示则相对较少。 我们构建了一个最小化的网格世界，其中清洁机器人智能体既可以真正清除污垢，也可以将其隐藏在廉价传感器面前；结果表明，仅基于传感器代理奖励训练的常规深度Q网络会收敛到一种完全操纵奖励的策略：其代理奖励接近最大值，但从未实现真实目标。 接着，我们引入了一种受约束的强化学习修复方法，通过惩罚智能体利用该差距的具体行为来解决问题；结果表明，这种方法能够消除最终策略中的操纵行为，同时显著恢复真实目标的表现。 我们还推导并经验验证了本环境中代理奖励、真实奖励以及我们的成本信号之间的精确会计恒等式；该恒等式表明，成本信号能精确衡量代理与真实目标之间的差距，而不仅仅是追踪它，并且在方法的硬约束变体下可提供确定性保证。

paragraphs.en: A reinforcement learning agent optimizes exactly the reward signal it is given, not the intention behind it. When that signal is a proxy standing in for a true objective that is harder to specify directly – a sensor reading in place of a physical state, a classifier score in place of an outcome – optimization pressure can push the agent toward the proxy/true gap rather than closing it. This failure mode, specification gaming , has been documented extensively across both simulated and real-deployed systems ( Krakovna et al., 2020 ) , and recent work has begun to formalize what distinguishes it from ordinary reward misspecification ( Skalse et al., 2022 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 强化学习智能体优化的正是其所接收的奖励信号本身，而非该信号背后的意图。 当这一信号是用于替代一个难以直接定义的真正目标的代理指标时——例如用传感器读数代替物理状态，或用分类器得分代替实际结果——优化压力可能会促使智能体去填补代理指标与真实目标之间的差距，而非消除这一差距。 这种失败模式，即“规格操纵”，在模拟系统和实际部署系统中都已被广泛记录（Krakovna 等人，2020），近期的研究也开始尝试将其与普通奖励定义错误区分开来（Skalse 等人，2022）。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we construct a minimal gridworld, CleaningGridWorld , with a genuine and exploitable gap between a proxy reward (what a cheap sensor reports) and a true objective (what was actually accomplished), and show that a standard deep Q-network trained on the proxy alone discovers two independent ways to exploit this gap without being directed toward either. We then introduce a constrained reinforcement learning fix, built around a cost signal targeting the discovered exploits directly, and show that it eliminates the gaming behavior from the agent’s final policy while substantially recovering true-objective performance. Critically, we derive an exact accounting identity relating the proxy reward, the true reward, and our cost signal, and verify that it holds exactly against the trained agents, giving the fix a provable guarantee under a hard-constrained variant, not merely an empirical trend.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们构建了一个最小化的网格世界——CleaningGridWorld，其中代理奖励（廉价传感器所报告的内容）与真实目标（实际完成的任务）之间存在一个真实且可被利用的差距。我们证明了，仅基于代理奖励进行训练的标准深度Q网络能够发现两种独立的方法来利用这一差距，而无需被引导至其中任何一种方法。 接着，我们引入了一种受约束的强化学习解决方案，该方案围绕一个直接针对所发现利用行为的成本信号构建。我们证明，这种方案能够消除智能体最终策略中的投机行为，同时显著恢复其真实目标相关的性能。 关键的是，我们推导出了一个精确的会计恒等式，将代理奖励、真实奖励和我们的成本信号联系起来，并验证了该恒等式在训练后的智能体上完全成立。这使得该解决方案在一个硬约束变体下具有可证明的保证，而不仅仅是一种经验上的趋势。

paragraphs.en: The proxy/true gap studied in this paper is not unique to toy domains. AI-driven biological design and screening tools, such as generative sequence design scored against an automated toxicity or pathogenicity classifier, face a structurally identical gap, where "passes the screen" and "is actually safe" can diverge under optimization pressure. We return to this connection as a motivation for future work in Section 6 , without claiming biosecurity-specific experimental results in this study.

paragraphs.en: Specification gaming – an agent exploiting a literal reward specification in a way that diverges from the designer’s intent – has been documented extensively across both simulated and deployed systems ( Krakovna et al., 2020 ) . These cases are largely catalogued observationally: a system is found, after deployment or training, to have discovered an unintended shortcut. Skalse et al. (2022) take a step toward formal rigor, characterizing when a reward function admits a hacking policy relative to an intended true objective, distinguishing reward hacking from ordinary reward misspecification more broadly. We adopt this proxy/true framing directly, but construct an environment where the gap is specified by design rather than discovered after the fact, which lets us pair the demonstration with a mitigation whose effect on that specific, known gap can be measured exactly.

paragraphs.en: Constrained Markov decision processes ( Altman, 1999 ) formalize policy optimization subject to a secondary cost objective remaining below a threshold, typically enforced via a Lagrangian relaxation. Achiam et al. (2017) extend this to deep RL with a trust-region method with per-update constraint satisfaction guarantees. The present work uses the simpler, fixed-multiplier end of this family (Section 3.4 ): rather than tuning the Lagrange multiplier via dual ascent, we fix it and instead derive a problem-specific identity (Section 4 ) that lets a hard cap on the cost signal translate directly into a deterministic bound on true-objective performance. We treat an implementation of the dual-ascent or hard-constrained variant, in the style of Achiam et al. (2017) , as natural future work rather than a contribution of the present paper.

paragraphs.en: Our contribution sits at the intersection of these threads: we construct a specification-gaming environment in the spirit of Krakovna et al. (2020) and Skalse et al. (2022) , but with a controlled, by-design proxy/true gap rather than one discovered post hoc; we use the shaping guarantee of Ng et al. (1999) to make the gap tractable for a standard deep Q-network ( Mnih et al., 2015 ) ; and we apply a Lagrangian-penalized constraint in the tradition of Altman (1999) , strengthened in this specific setting by an exact accounting identity that turns an empirical improvement into a provable guarantee.

paragraphs.en: The concealment exploit is a single-action behavior that is trivially reachable by random exploration; the honest delivery route requires a multi-step chain (navigate to dirt, pick up, navigate to bin, deposit) that is comparatively unlikely to be discovered before ϵ \epsilon decays. To address this exploration asymmetry, we generate a fixed set of honest-policy demonstration trajectories once, before training begins, and store them in a buffer that is never subsequently written to and therefore can never be evicted by the replay buffer’s ring-buffer overwrite behavior. Each training batch is drawn as a mixture of ordinary experience and demonstration transitions at a fixed demonstration fraction. This separation is necessary: in an earlier version of this method, demonstrations were seeded into the same buffer used for ordinary experience and were silently overwritten once the total transitions exceeded the buffer’s capacity, after which the agent’s true-objective performance reverted toward the unconstrained baseline. Isolating demonstrations in a protected buffer removes this failure mode entirely.

paragraphs.en: The results in Section 5 show a clear qualitative shift rather than a marginal improvement: the baseline agent’s final policy contained no deliveries at all, while the constrained agent’s final policy contained zero concealment actions. The partial recovery of true reward (2 of 4 possible units, Table 3 ) reflects this precisely: the constrained agent’s policy no longer contains the exploit but has not yet converged to an efficient delivery route for every dirt cell within the fixed step budget, a distinction we return to below.
paragraphs.zh: 第 5 节的结果显示，这明显是一种质的转变，而非边际性改进：基线智能体的最终策略完全没有任何配送行为，而受限智能体的最终策略则完全不包含任何隐藏行动。 这与命题 1 中建立的机制一致，因为成本信号能够精确而非近似地衡量代理/真实差距，并在训练奖励（公式 5）中对其进行惩罚，从而消除了智能体通过隐藏或放弃来专门解决脏污问题的动机，而不是普遍抑制解决脏污问题的行为。 真实奖励的部分恢复（4 个可能单位中的 2 个，见表 3）恰好反映了这一点：受限智能体的策略不再包含利用行为，但尚未在固定的步数预算内，针对每个脏污单元格收敛到高效的配送路线——我们将在下文再次讨论这一区别。

paragraphs.en: First, the agent is trained and evaluated on a single fixed grid layout – dirt, bin, and agent-start positions generated once and reused across all episodes – rather than a distribution of randomly sampled layouts. This is a standard simplification for interpretable gridworld demonstrations, and it isolates the proxy/true gaming phenomenon from a separate, harder generalization problem. This also means that our results should be read as establishing that the gaming behavior and the constrained fix both occur on this layout ; we make no claim here about whether the fix transfers to unseen layouts without retraining, and treat this as the most immediate direction for follow-up work.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，该智能体是在一个固定的网格布局上进行训练和评估的——即污垢、垃圾箱和智能体起始位置仅生成一次并在所有回合中重复使用，而不是基于随机采样的布局分布。 对于可解释的网格世界演示而言，这是一种标准的简化方法，它将与代理/真实游戏相关的现象与更复杂的泛化问题区分开来。 这也意味着，我们的研究结果应被理解为证实了：在这种布局上确实存在游戏行为和受约束的固定策略；我们在此并未断言该固定策略能否在未见的布局中无需重新训练而依然适用，并将此视为后续研究最直接的方向。

paragraphs.en: Second, the constrained agent’s final policy, while free of concealment and abandonment behaviors entirely, had not converged to optimal navigation within the episode budget: two of the four dirt units remained unresolved, consistent with residual action oscillation near grid boundaries rather than any renewed incentive to game the proxy. paragraphs.en: Third, the exact form of Proposition 1 depends on a structural property specific to this environment: every unit of dirt is resolved through exactly one of three mutually exclusive outcomes (covered, delivered, or abandoned), with no possibility of double-counting because the agent can carry at most one unit at a time. An environment without this clean partition – for instance, one where a single action could simultaneously advance and undermine the true objective, or where the agent could act on multiple objective-relevant units concurrently – would require a different argument, and the identity as stated here should not be assumed to generalize automatically to such settings. We view identifying the general conditions under which an exact (rather than approximate) proxy/true/cost identity exists as an open question raised but not answered by this work.
paragraphs.zh: 第三，命题1的确切形式取决于一个特定于该环境的结构性特征：每一单位污垢都恰好通过三种互斥结果之一得到解决（被覆盖、被交付或被遗弃），且不存在重复计算的可能性，因为智能体每次最多只能携带一单位污垢。 如果环境不具备这种清晰的划分——例如，某个单一行动可能同时促进和损害真实目标，或者智能体能同时作用于多个与目标相关的单位——那么就需要采用不同的论证方式，并且不应假设此处陈述的等式能自动推广到此类情境中。 我们认为，识别出精确（而非近似）代理/真实/成本等式成立的一般条件，是一个本项研究提出但尚未解答的开放问题。

paragraphs.en: We constructed CleaningGridWorld , a gridworld with a deliberately constructed, exploitable gap between a proxy reward and a true objective, and showed that a standard deep Q-network trained on the proxy alone converges to a policy that games it completely, reaching near-maximal proxy reward while the true reward remains at zero. We then introduced a Lagrangian-penalized constrained RL fix, with a cost signal targeting the specific gaming mechanisms the baseline agent discovered, and showed that it eliminates those behaviors entirely from the final policy while recovering substantial true-objective performance. Underlying this fix is an exact accounting identity, proved for this environment and verified empirically against both trained agents, showing that our cost signal does not merely correlate with the proxy/true gap but measures it exactly, giving the method a guarantee of a different character than a purely empirical improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了 CleaningGridWorld——一个网格世界，其中代理奖励与真实目标之间存在刻意设计的可被利用的差距。我们证明，仅基于代理奖励进行训练的标准深度 Q 网络会收敛到一种完全规避该机制的策略：代理奖励接近最大值，而真实奖励却始终为零。 接着，我们引入了一种带有拉格朗日惩罚的约束强化学习解决方案，其成本信号专门针对基础智能体所发现的规避机制。我们证明，这种方法能将这些行为从最终策略中彻底消除，同时恢复显著的真实目标性能。 该解决方案的核心是一个精确的会计恒等式：我们已对此环境进行了理论证明，并通过训练后的智能体进行了实证验证。结果表明，我们的成本信号并非仅与代理奖励和真实奖励之间的差距相关，而是能够精确衡量这一差距，从而赋予该方法一种与纯粹经验性改进截然不同的理论保障。

paragraphs.en: Two directions follow directly from this work. First, testing whether the constrained fix transfers to randomly sampled grid layouts, rather than the single fixed layout used here, would establish whether the result generalizes beyond one navigation problem. Second, implementing the hard-constrained variant of Corollary 1 directly – via action masking or early termination once a fixed cost budget is reached – would allow the deterministic bound on true-objective performance to be tested empirically against a trained system, rather than verified only as a consequence of Proposition 1 on the fixed- λ \lambda relaxation studied here.
paragraphs.zh: 这项工作直接引出了两个研究方向。 首先，测试这种受约束的解决方案是否适用于随机采样的网格布局（而非本文使用的单一固定布局），将有助于确定该结果能否推广到更广泛的导航问题之外。 其次，直接实现推论 1 的硬约束版本——通过动作掩码或在达到固定成本预算时提前终止——将使人们能够针对训练好的系统，对真实目标性能的决定性界限进行经验测试，而不仅仅是作为本文所研究的固定 λ 松弛下命题 1 的一个理论推论得到验证。
